contribution.position: Reliability evidence is incomplete for a session-store migration. Functional tests and peak-load p99 look healthy, but neither exercises the dual-write path, and the runbook lists the dual-write soak test as TODO and never run. Last quarter's two sev2 incidents were both retry storms, a failure mode that dual-write and cutover can plausibly trigger, and nothing here shows the migration is protected against it. Until the soak test runs and retry/backoff behavior under dual-write is shown, the reliability case rests on untested ground. Passing tests (412/0, 87% coverage) and the perf report speak to correctness and steady-state latency, not to sustained dual-write or retry amplification.
